title: StyleStream 2.0: Fast and Controllable Streaming Voice Style Conversion
abstract: arXiv:2610.28940v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Voice style conversion (VSC) aims to transform a source utterance to match the timbre, accent, and emotion of a target voice while preserving linguistic content. StyleStream 1.0 introduced the first streamable zero-shot VSC system with state-of-the-art conversion quality, but remained limited in two ways: approximately 1s end-to-end latency on consumer hardware, and the lack of a text-based interface for designing or editing target voices. We present StyleStream 2.0, a fast and controllable streaming VSC framework that addresses these limitations. To reduce latency, we train a few-step pixel MeanFlow model and further fine-tune it with autoregressive feedback inspired by Self Forcing, improving robustness under streaming inference. This reduces end-to-end latency to 520~ms on a consumer GPU, a 2x speedup over StyleStream 1.0, while maintaining conversion quality. To enable controllable style manipulation, we remove the mel-spectrogram

translated_title: StyleStream 2.0：快速且可控的流式语音风格转换
translated_abstract: 语音风格转换（VSC）旨在将源语音转换为目标语音的音色、口音和情感，同时保留语言内容。StyleStream 1.0 引入了首个可流式处理的零样本语音风格转换系统，具有最先进的转换质量，但仍存在两个局限：在消费级硬件上约 1 秒的端到端延迟，以及缺乏基于文本的界面来设计或编辑目标语音。我们提出 StyleStream 2.0，这是一个快速且可控的流式语音风格转换框架，解决了上述局限。为了降低延迟，我们训练了一个少步数的像素级 MeanFlow 模型，并进一步使用受 Self Forcing 启发的自回归反馈对其进行微调，从而提高了流式推理下的鲁棒性。这将消费级 GPU 上的端到端延迟降低至 520 毫秒，比 StyleStream 1.0 提速 2 倍，同时保持了转换质量。为实现可控的风格操控，我们移除了梅尔频谱图（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: StyleStream 2.0 通过少步数像素级 MeanFlow 模型和受 Self Forcing 启发的自回归反馈微调，将流式语音风格转换的端到端延迟降低至 520 毫秒（较 1.0 版本提速 2 倍），并支持基于文本的可控语音风格设计。
en_tdlr: StyleStream 2.0 achieves fast and controllable streaming voice style conversion by training a few-step pixel MeanFlow model fine-tuned with Self Forcing-inspired autoregressive feedback, cutting end-to-end latency to 520 ms (a 2x speedup) while enabling text-based voice style design and editing.
